what: Among several horizontal panels, only one is a wide rounded panel (width = The open panel (line width − folded panels, height 480px, corner radius 20px) stays open, and the rest are 95px-wide pill columns (height 400px, corner radius 47.5px) with the name lying sideways. When the mouse hovers over a column (or it is pressed or focused), that panel opens over .75s power3.inOut, changing width, height and corner radius together, while the previous panel folds back into a column. The vertical name switches off at .375s when opening and switches back on .3s after folding, and the text and images inside the panel rise from 14px below after .26s, staggered .05s apart, over .6s. Below 1024px, pressing a vertically stacked header line opens only that panel’s height over .6s.

options.[data-fx-part=item]: One board — colors come from style’s --fx-item-bg and --fx-item-ink
options.[data-fx-part=trigger]·[data-fx-part=tab: Panel head button and the name inside it (turns vertical in a row)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]·[data-fx-part=body]: Open panel contents · box inside (width tied to the open width so text does not reflow while folding) · rising pieces
options.height·low: Open panel and folded column heights, default 480·400 (original defaults are 559·467 — the first page was called with 480·400)
options.gap·radius: Gap between panels · open panel corner radius, default 10 · 20
options.breakpoint: From this width, a row, default 1024
options.trigger: If click, it does not open on mouse hover (only on press), default hover
options.fx:open: Event the element emits when the panel changes (detail.index) — used to play only the open panel’s video
